title: Number Field
description: Lets the shopper type a number or step it up and down with buttons at either end, within a minimum and maximum, such as a quantity. Fills its Field like other controls; never narrower than its two buttons and three digits.

components.NumberField: Groups all parts of the number field.
components.NumberFieldContent: Groups the number input with its decrement and increment buttons.
components.NumberFieldDecrement: Lowers the value of the number field by one step.
components.NumberFieldIncrement: Raises the value of the number field by one step.
components.NumberFieldInput: Lets the user type a number into the number field.
